title: Geologic map of the Irmo Northeast quadrangle, Richland and Fairfield Counties, South Carolina
citation: Secor, D.T., Jr., and Howard, C.S., 2016, Geologic map of the Irmo Northeast quadrangle, Richland and Fairfield Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report 223, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face and correlation chart garbled. Unit ages from the correlation chart not recorded (unit-to-age pairing not legible). Symbols garbled for the quartz crystal metatuff ('Zpfat'), upland gravels, Emory ('€eu') and lower Richtex ('Zers1') members; 'TOc' read as TQc (OCR rule, review). Lower Richtex layer thickness '| - 10 mm' read as 1 (review). Faults, synforms, antiforms, foliation and lineation symbols, sample sites known only from the legend/map not recorded. Harbison Granite age sentence is cut off in the OCR.
SUBSURFACE: section A-A' (p.1) has vertical scales in FEET (4000 to -4000) and METERS (1220 to -1220), SEA LEVEL datum, no vertical exaggeration; units Ers2, Cwqm, Zpft2, Cp are legible but their positions/elevations are not; end locations not stated; Cp bodies on the section are hypothetical. Elevations in text: colluvium from about 320' to 190'; upland gravels cap hills above 330'; kaolinitic sand dips SE about 35 ft per mile (no datum stated). Map vertical datum not stated (horizontal 1927 North American Datum).
